headline: Lima Stock Exchange Index Companies Post Record S/ 14.4 Billion Q3 Profits
summary: Companies forming part of the Lima Stock Exchange Select Index earned 14,455 million soles in the third quarter of 2026, up 46% year-on-year.
why: Corporate earnings reports from benchmark index constituents provide key insights into overall corporate profitability and local market valuation.

impacts.name: Lima Stock Exchange
impacts.why: Substantially higher corporate earnings improve equity valuations across index constituents.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong profit growth across major listed companies drives positive momentum on domestic stock exchanges.
